probe.projection_space: supervised ridge and sine/cosine probe outputs

complexity_measures.linear: ridge effective degrees of freedom = sum(s_j^2/(s_j^2+lambda))
complexity_measures.circular_cls: sinusoidal code dimension; hidden projection width fixed at 100

pls_transfer.probe: PLS scalar magnitude decoder; independently fitted within each prompt family.
pls_transfer.capacity_selection: Native-family development choices from the April 20 sweep.
pls_transfer.direction_comparison: Signed cosine between unit scalar decoder weight vectors at the same checkpoint and layer.
pls_transfer.transfer: Freeze source-family direction, gain, and intercept, and test the other family activations.
pls_transfer.alignment: Translate each family's training-activation mean to the equal-family global training mean; freeze source direction and gain. Target labels are unused.
pls_transfer.averaging: Equal weights for six models, eleven relative layers, and applicable family pairs. Compute angles before averaging.

bootstrap.seed_derivation: first four little-endian bytes of SHA256("20260915::" + task_id + "::bootstrap")
bootstrap.interpretation: conditional on ten frozen fitted bases; evaluation uncertainty only

steering_accuracy.metric: argmax numeric output equals target_output, or differs by at most 10; nonnumeric outputs fail
steering_accuracy.reported_mae: legacy probability-weighted expected numeric output, a different metric

bootstrap.zero_exact_success: report zero/n and omit degenerate bootstrap interval

coefficient_prediction.dose: differs across methods; settings selected on development contexts

parity.counts: fixed baseline-correct classification and enumeration evaluation sets; descriptive frequencies
parity.uncertainty: no binomial population interpretation or intervals from the archived counts

aggregation.x: maximum family-specific complexity across the same five families at each matched capacity step
aggregation.y: arithmetic mean of test MAE over five prompt families

complexity_definition.interpretation: Compare tuning trends within each probe family; equal axis values identify different fitted objects across families.
complexity_definition.storage_field: The historical JSONL field effective_df retains its name and all original values.

appendix_capacity.data_level: Frozen per-model/depth/setting averages of five prompt-family test MAEs; underlying family rows not included.
appendix_capacity.uncertainty: One fixed value-disjoint split; no refit/evaluation intervals in this aggregate bundle.
